revisions.scope: final cross-module/cross-subject reconciliation: Cross-subject/in-subject link reconciliation. Aliases removed: lsb "lowest bit" (opened LSB for "lowest set bit" in DSA), implementation-defined "implementation-specific" (generic usage elsewhere and in-subject), instruction-encoding "machine instruction(s)" (meant instructions, not their encoding), short-circuit "short-circuits" (electrical sense in Synth), code-point "code space" (base62 code space in System Design), control-code "control code" (software sense in Synth; term renamed "Control character"), status-flag "status flags" (file-status flags in OS; term renamed "Status flag"), mac-address bare "MAC" (multiply-accumulate is the Architecture sense; moved to 06 mac), optimiser "optimisation" (general optimisations). Definitions broadened: short-circuit (early-exit comparisons), bit-field (records/packet headers), byte-order (order of bytes generally). Off-by-one phrase "2 multiplied by itself n times" replaced with "n copies of 2 multiplied together": 14 replacements in rep-number-systems, rep-integers, rep-bitwise lessons and questions.
